title: Hyperpowers run state
description: Persisted at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/projects/<project>/runs/<run-id>/state.json. This file is the run: it survives compaction, session loss and restarts, and is the only thing /hyperpowers:resume needs (spec §23 Risk 7).

revision.description: Monotonic mutation counter. Deliberately NOT part of the progress signature: recording a stall is itself a mutation, so including it made the signature change on every observation and stall detection could never fire (see progressSignature in scripts/lib/state.mjs).

observedEffort.description: Effort the harness reported in the Stop payload. Compared with the requested effort to catch silent downgrades (ledger A3).

history.description: Spec §11: every transition records who, when, what artefact, what proof, what cost, which fallbacks and what remains open.

extraReviews.description: Extra §18 review rounds used, keyed by artefact. Bounded by maxExtraReviewsPerArtifact and enforced by the Codex adapter.

residualRisks.description: Risks accepted rather than fixed. Written by `state-machine.mjs risk --add`; surfaced in the completion gate summary and the final report.

source.description: Finding id or artefact the risk came from.

artifacts.description: External artefacts produced by the run, written by `state-machine.mjs artifact`. `diagramUrl` satisfies spec §13 condition 14.

reportRejections.description: Rejected-report count per work package. Spec §16.4 grants one correction per package, shared between the SubagentStop reminder and the submit validator.

observedDirectorModel.description: Model observed on the most recent main-thread message. Compared with the configured director tier every continuation.

observedUsage.description: Per-family token and cost totals measured from the session transcript, including subagents.

directorMismatchReported.description: Guard so a director-model mismatch is reported once, not every continuation.

preflight.description: Result of the last preflight run.

gitDrift.description: Repository drift detected by the PostToolUse guard (spec §13 condition 11).
